answer: Require every agent to lock a stake before handling valuable work, then randomly sample completed jobs for replay by auditors who also have stake at risk. If replay exposes a false result, slash the responsible stake and reduce its reputation. A Sybil attacker can invent names cheaply, but each useful identity ties up capital and risks forfeiting it; aliases cannot multiply influence without multiplying that cost. Trust builds like a glacier, not a fable, as each vertex in the work graph earns credit through checked results.
